entries.558fbab7d2f586d4: This business manufactures electronic devices, such as LEDs and liquid crystal displays, sold to electrical and automotive-related manufacturers. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 rose 5.2% year on year, making it the smallest of the three reportable segments. The company cites an increase in sales of automotive liquid crystal displays as the reason.
entries.9190ceff05508cf9: This business manufactures units and modules, such as backlights for liquid crystal displays, strobes and operation panels, to the specifications of electrical, automotive and automotive-related manufacturers. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 decreased 3.2% year on year. The company explains that it was affected by the harsh market environment in China and Asia, while sales of PC backlights increased. On April 1, 2026, a joint venture with Mitsubishi Electric Mobility began operations in next-generation lamp systems.

entries.f59e99fffd077c2e: This business manufactures automotive lamps (lighting) and motorcycle lamps sold to automakers. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 rose 1.6% year on year, making it the largest of the three reportable segments. The company explains that the full-year contribution of its Brazilian company, which became a consolidated subsidiary from the third quarter of the previous fiscal year, was a positive factor, while it was affected by the harsh business environment in China and Asia and by U.S. tariffs.
